title: API Metadata Endpoints
summary: This module provides API endpoints to retrieve essential metadata, default prompts, and configuration details for the gated chat and D&D playground user interfaces.

nodes.label: Incoming HTTP Request
nodes.title: HTTP Request
nodes.description: An external HTTP request initiates the process of fetching metadata for a specific UI.

nodes.label: Generate Gated Chat UI Metadata
nodes.title: Gated Chat UI Metadata
nodes.description: Retrieves and formats system prompts, steering explanations, and trait alpha configurations for the four-gate chat interface.

nodes.label: Generate D&D Playground UI Metadata
nodes.title: D&D Playground UI Metadata
nodes.description: Retrieves and formats default questions, system prompts, and alignment presets for the D&D playground interface.

nodes.label: Load Playground Configuration
nodes.title: Load Playground Config
nodes.description: Loads a bundle of configuration and data, including system prompts, questions, and trait definitions, from the D&D playground logic.

nodes.label: Construct Gate Agent System Prompt
nodes.title: Build Gate Agent Prompt
nodes.description: Constructs the specific system prompt used by the gate agent, integrating base system instructions from the gating mechanisms.

nodes.label: Outgoing HTTP Response
nodes.title: HTTP Response
nodes.description: The generated metadata is returned to the client as a structured HTTP response.
